text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Pardon me for using your desk.

With a brief word of courtesy,
North Flight begins pulling fresh confections out of
the bag she's holding, one after another.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Four slices of cake,
two cream puffs,
and then...
choice_data_list: You bought quite a lot of sweets, huh...
You bought quite a lot of sweets, didn't you...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: No, actually, they were all gifts.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Fu-chan, you like sweet things, right?
Um, to thank you for picking out my clothes the other day—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! I brought a thank-you gift for Fuu-sama!
Thanks to your outfit advice last week,
my date was a total success~!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It looks like those kids went out of their way to sneak out during lunch break and buy snacks in front of the station.
...Honestly, they really didn't need to thank me.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
A-And all those thank-you gifts
just happened to pile up, you see.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I can't let their kindness go to waste, so I was thinking of somehow eating it all up today.
choice_data_list: Eat... all of these fresh sweets!?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If you chose it wanting me to be happy...
—finishing every bite is all part of the set.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if it means I won't have room for dinner,
I'd like to prioritize these feelings and eat it."

However, that is visibly a large amount of sweets.
It seems like it might affect her weight management, but...
choice_data_list: ...Would it be alright if I helped?
...Would it be alright if I helped?
You really cherish the feelings you've been given.
You really cherish the feelings you've been given.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Huh? The Trainer is?
choice_data_list: Right, like eating together, among other things—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that burns off
two slices' worth of cake calories.
choice_data_list: Time to burn off those cream puffs next!
Time to burn off those cream puffs next!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Yes, please~♪

And on this day, aside from the usual training,
she worked through a calorie-burning routine.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes. And so—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to everyone's kind hospitality,
I'd like to fill my belly to my heart's content today♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Mmm, so sweeet♪

And so, North Flight devoured the entire desk full of
sweets all by herself...!
